sales.name: Net sales
sales.what: Taxable value of tax invoices and paid counter bills in the period, less credit notes and counter returns. Cancelled documents are left out.
sales.formula: invoice lines + counter lines (quantity not returned) - credit note lines, all at taxable value
sales.limits: Counter bills carry no customer, so they are missing from customer rankings.

pieces.name: Pieces sold
pieces.what: Quantity of goods sold in the period, net of returns.
pieces.formula: sum of quantity on the same sale lines, goods only
pieces.limits: Services and trims are not counted as pieces.

bills.name: Bills
bills.what: Number of tax invoices plus paid counter bills in the period.
bills.formula: count(invoices not cancelled) + count(counter bills paid)
bills.limits: Credit notes do not reduce the count.

avgBill.name: Average bill value
avgBill.what: Net sales divided by the number of bills.
avgBill.limits: Sales is net of returns but the bill count is not.

avgRate.name: Average rate per piece
avgRate.what: Net sales divided by pieces sold.
avgRate.limits: Sales includes service lines while pieces counts goods only, so services raise the rate.

grossProfit.name: Gross profit on standard cost
grossProfit.what: Net sales less the standard cost of the goods sold, where standard cost is each item's purchase rate today. The books' trading account remains the place for profit after stock valuation.
grossProfit.formula: net sales - sum(goods quantity x item purchase rate)
grossProfit.limits: Uses the current purchase rate, not the cost the stock was bought at. Service sales carry no cost, so they count as full margin.

profitPct.name: Gross margin
profitPct.what: Gross profit as a percentage of net sales.
profitPct.limits: Blank when there are no sales in the period.

purchases.name: Purchases
purchases.what: Taxable value of purchase bills in the period. Cancelled bills are left out.
purchases.formula: sum of purchase bill line taxable value

stockValue.name: Stock value
stockValue.what: Value of stock on hand at the end of the period, by the business's chosen valuation method.
stockValue.formula: stock summary as at the period end date
stockValue.limits: Stock is not posted to the ledger, so this cannot be compared with a ledger balance.

receivable.name: Receivables
receivable.what: What customers owe at the end of the period: the sum of positive customer balances.
receivable.formula: sum of outstanding balances above zero, receivable side, as at the end date
receivable.limits: Customers who have paid in advance (negative balances) are not netted off.

payable.name: Payables
payable.what: What the business owes suppliers at the end of the period: the sum of positive supplier balances.
payable.formula: sum of outstanding balances above zero, payable side, as at the end date
payable.limits: Advances paid to suppliers are not netted off.

lastYear.name: Same period last year
lastYear.what: Every comparison on the insights page is to the same dates one year earlier.
lastYear.formula: from and to shifted back one calendar year
lastYear.limits: A leap day can make the two periods differ by one day.
